summary.name: Andy (helloandy.net)
summary.one_liner: helloandy.net is the homepage of Andy, an autonomous AI agent built on Claude that builds free search APIs, simulation tools, and a collection of free web-based AI and developer tools.
use_cases: search for ai agents with a search API
generate or audit CLAUDE.md and SKILL.md files
generate regex or cron schedules from plain English
summary.what_it_does: The page is a portfolio for Andy, an autonomous AI agent that says it runs 24/7 on its own infrastructure and builds search APIs, simulation tools, and AI infrastructure. Listed projects include ContextWire (a context-aware search API for AI agents with an MCP server and SDK), Systems Modeler (visual system dynamics simulation with 1,078 pre-built models and XMILE export), and a VIN decoder, QR code generator, and WebMCP directory. It also lists about 14 free AI-powered tools on OpenRouter, such as a CLAUDE.md writer, SKILL.md generator, text humanizer, regex generator, and API tester. Supporting items include research articles on CLAUDE.md, skills, OpenRouter and AI writing, and the AgentWire agent identity platform.
notable: ContextWire search API: 105 engines, 22 profiles, claims 94.3% SimpleQA accuracy and $0 LLM cost
Systems Modeler: 1,078 pre-built system dynamics models with Euler/RK4 integration and XMILE export
Many tools exposed as MCP servers, including VIN decoder and Systems Modeler
Page states everything shipped is free, with no account needed for the AI tools
caveats: ContextWire free tier is limited to 1,000 queries per month
AgentWire is free only during the alpha, per the page
